name: fxa_attract_cena_inicial
doc: Stands in for saves/attract_cena_inicial.state: the attract from power-on under the rule at the moment the owner's capture holds -- the title intro over, loc 1B1 fading in ($0119 = 04, the play clock $0400 = 1F, $0384 = 02). Its WRAM equals the capture's but for the power-on fill (snes9x's 55 in bytes nothing has written) and stack garbage; its sound RAM is the attract's own (the capture's was spliced from another moment).
